cards.name: Shoe
cards.summary: Symbol 'Shoe' from Illustrator's Fashion symbol library: a solid flat orange silhouette, in side view, of a strappy high-heeled sandal with a thin stiletto heel on the left and open toe straps on the right. (Thumbnail: one instance placed from the library and fitted to 300 pt on white, applied by script; natural size about 27 x 10 pt; not a shipped preview.)
avoid: detail: this is a flat silhouette with no seams or texture; for a detailed garment draw your own
flat or closed shoes: use Slipper or Boot
large prints at natural size: it is only about 27 x 10 pt; scale it up
cards.applies_to: the artboard of an open document: placing it creates a symbol instance, a linked copy of the symbol definition that can be moved, scaled and rotated like any object; the symbol must exist in the target document (placing from the library copies it in)
cards.how_to_apply: Panel: Window > Symbol Libraries > Fashion; click the symbol (it is added to the Symbols panel), then drag it onto the artboard or press Place Symbol Instance. Script: doc.symbolItems.add(doc.symbols.getByName("Shoe")) in a document that holds the symbol; to use it in another document: app.open("<Illustrator 2026 install folder>/Presets/en_US/Symbols/Fashion.ai"), place an instance there, item.duplicate(target.layers[0], ElementPlacement.PLACEATEND) (the symbol arrives in the target document), then close the library with SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES.

verified.note: Flat orange side-view strappy sandal with a thin high heel at left and toe straps at right.

cards.summary: Symbol 'Rosebud' from Illustrator's Flowers symbol library: a closed red-orange rosebud on a teal-green stem with two leaves. (Thumbnail: one instance placed from the library and fitted to 300 pt on white, applied by script; natural size about 48 x 51 pt; not a shipped preview.)
use_for: flower-sprig accents in cards and borders
avoid: photographic realism: this is a stylised vector illustration
a full bloom: use Red Rose or Rose
cards.applies_to: the artboard of an open document: placing it creates a symbol instance, a linked copy of the symbol definition that can be moved, scaled and rotated like any object; the symbol must exist in the target document (placing from the library copies it in)
cards.how_to_apply: Panel: Window > Symbol Libraries > Flowers; click the symbol (it is added to the Symbols panel), then drag it onto the artboard or press Place Symbol Instance. Script: doc.symbolItems.add(doc.symbols.getByName("Rosebud")) in a document that holds the symbol; to use it in another document: app.open("<Illustrator 2026 install folder>/Presets/en_US/Symbols/Flowers.ai"), place an instance there, item.duplicate(target.layers[0], ElementPlacement.PLACEATEND) (the symbol arrives in the target document), then close the library with SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES.

verified.note: Closed red-orange rosebud on a teal-green stem with leaves.
